name: Flower & Leaf Cluster Drops
materials: PVD steel, non-tarnish
story:
These grow downward like a stem. A pale blossom at the top, a green enamel leaf, then a blue daisy at the end of the line. I link them one at a time with the pliers until the drop hangs straight.

They move when you turn your head, which is the whole point.

adBody: Blossom, leaf, and daisy linked into one gold drop that moves when you do. Sold as individual, changeable charms. Can also be worn on an invisible chain.

story:
Thin gold hoops, and a handful of flower charms that slide on and off. Pink blossom today, a yellow one tomorrow, a violet four-petal flower or a green daisy when the mood changes.

One pair of hoops, a different flower whenever you like. These are the ones people ask about.

materials: PVD steel, non-tarnish
story:
The hoop opens and the bead slides off, so one pair of hoops can be orange today and sky blue tomorrow. I keep the beads in a row on the felt: orange, hot pink, lime, purple, pink, sky blue, green, red, cream.

Start with one color or take the whole set.

name: Tibetan Bead Drops
materials: PVD steel, non-tarnish
story:
The beads are the heavy, detailed kind: dark centers wrapped in twisted gold wire, set with turquoise and coral. I wire-wrap each one into a loop by hand so it hangs cleanly from the hook.

One is all blue-green stones in a gold cage. One has red and turquoise dots between gold swirls. Both feel old in the hand.

adBody: Inlaid Tibetan-style beads, wire-wrapped by hand into a single drop. Sold as individual, changeable charms. Can also be worn on an invisible chain.

name: Throat Blossom
materials: PVD steel, non-tarnish
story:
The clasp was already on when I lifted it from the bench. A fine gold chain, and the blossom rests at the hollow of the throat. Pink enamel, gold along every petal, a tiny stone at the heart.

It is light on purpose. One flower, close to the skin, so an ordinary day has a single bright thing at the collarbone.

adBody: A pink enamel blossom on a fine gold chain, worn close to the skin. Sold as individual, changeable charms. Can also be worn on an invisible chain.

name: First Blossom
materials: Pink enamel, gold PVD steel, a tiny clear stone, non-tarnish
story:
They were still loose on the white bench when the morning light found them. Three pink blossoms, each petal edged in gold. Two hold a tiny clear stone at the heart. One already wears its clasp, ready for a chain. At the edge of the table, a pale daisy the color of the inside of a shell.

I make them small on purpose. A flower you can close your hand around, then wear at the throat on an ordinary Tuesday, so the day has one bright thing in it.
adHeadline: A blossom you can hold
adBody: Pink enamel, gold at every edge, and a pale daisy waiting beside them.
socialCaption: On the bench this morning: three pink blossoms and a pale daisy. One clasp is already on.
